# 1. Setup

```{python}
import shutil
from pathlib import Path

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from py.config import cfg
from py.utils_dates import make_quarter_tbl, quarter_end

rquarters = make_quarter_tbl(
    start_year=cfg.start_year,
    end_year=2025,
    start_month_day="0101",
    end_month_day="1231",
)

rquarters["rquarter"] = rquarters["date"].apply(quarter_end)
rquarters = rquarters.loc[rquarters["rquarter"] >= pd.Timestamp("1999-01-01")][["rquarter"]].drop_duplicates().sort_values("rquarter")

qa_dir_05 = cfg.qa_dir / "05"
qa_dir_05.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
```

# 2. Functions

```{python}
def build_holdext_raw() -> pd.DataFrame:
    all_path = cfg.derived_dir / "all_holdings.parquet"
    extract_path = cfg.derived_dir / "holdext_raw_parquet.parquet"

    if not extract_path.exists():
        all_holdings = pd.read_parquet(all_path)

        key_cols = [
            "nameOfIssuer",
            "titleOfClass",
            "cusip",
            "value",
            "shrsOrPrnAmt",
            "investmentDiscretion",
            "votingAuthority",
            "shares",
        ]

        mask_empty = all_holdings[key_cols].isna().all(axis=1)
        out = all_holdings.loc[~mask_empty, [
            "filename",
            "cik",
            "cikname",
            "rdate",
            "fdate",
            "nameOfIssuer",
            "cusip",
            "value",
            "shares",
        ]].copy()

        out.to_parquet(extract_path, index=False)

    return pd.read_parquet(extract_path)


def clean_dates(holdext_raw: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    out = holdext_raw.copy()

    out["rdate"] = pd.to_datetime(out["rdate"], errors="coerce")
    out["fdate"] = pd.to_datetime(out["fdate"], errors="coerce")

    fixes = {
        "0000080255-03-000400.txt": pd.Timestamp("2002-12-31"),
        "0000905148-07-001531.txt": pd.Timestamp("2006-09-30"),
        "0001103882-11-000001.txt": pd.Timestamp("2010-09-30"),
    }

    out["rdate"] = out.apply(
        lambda r: fixes.get(r["filename"], r["rdate"]),
        axis=1,
    )

    same_date = out["rdate"] == out["fdate"]
    out.loc[same_date, "rdate"] = out.loc[same_date, "fdate"].apply(
        lambda d: d.to_period("Q").start_time - pd.Timedelta(days=1)
    )

    out["rquarter"] = out["rdate"].apply(quarter_end)
    out = out.loc[out["rquarter"] >= pd.Timestamp("1999-01-01")].copy()

    return out


def select_canonical_filings(holdext_raw: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    base = (
        holdext_raw.groupby(["cik", "rquarter", "filename"], dropna=False)
        .agg(n_holdings=("filename", "size"), fdate=("fdate", "max"))
        .reset_index()
    )

    base["max_n"] = base.groupby(["cik", "rquarter"], dropna=False)["n_holdings"].transform("max")
    cand = base.loc[base["n_holdings"] == base["max_n"]].copy()

    cand = cand.sort_values(["cik", "rquarter", "fdate"]).groupby(["cik", "rquarter"], dropna=False).tail(1)

    keep = cand[["cik", "rquarter", "filename"]].copy()

    out = holdext_raw.merge(keep, on=["cik", "rquarter", "filename"], how="inner")
    return out


def clean_cusip(holdext_raw: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    out = holdext_raw.copy()
    out["cusip"] = out["cusip"].astype(str).str.strip().str.upper()
    out["cusip_len"] = out["cusip"].str.len()
    out = out.loc[out["cusip_len"] >= 7].drop(columns=["cusip_len"]).copy()
    return out


def filter_outliers(holdext_raw: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    value_cap = holdext_raw["value"].quantile(0.999)
    shares_cap = holdext_raw["shares"].quantile(0.999)

    return holdext_raw.loc[
        (holdext_raw["value"].isna() | (holdext_raw["value"] <= value_cap))
        & (holdext_raw["shares"].isna() | (holdext_raw["shares"] <= shares_cap))
    ].copy()


def detect_unit_switches(holdext_raw: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    conversion_date = pd.Timestamp("2023-01-03")

    value_panel = (
        holdext_raw.groupby(["cik", "rquarter"], dropna=False)
        .agg(
            fdate=("fdate", "max"),
            portfolio_value=("value", "sum"),
            holdings_count=("value", "size"),
        )
        .reset_index()
        .sort_values(["cik", "rquarter"])
    )

    value_panel["first_fdate"] = value_panel.groupby("cik")["fdate"].transform("min")
    value_panel["initial_state"] = (value_panel["first_fdate"] >= conversion_date).astype(int)

    value_panel["lag_value"] = value_panel.groupby("cik")["portfolio_value"].shift(1)
    value_panel["lag_holdings"] = value_panel.groupby("cik")["holdings_count"].shift(1)

    value_panel["value_ratio"] = np.where(
        (value_panel["lag_value"].notna()) & (value_panel["lag_value"] > 0),
        value_panel["portfolio_value"] / value_panel["lag_value"],
        np.nan,
    )
    value_panel["holdings_ratio"] = np.where(
        (value_panel["lag_holdings"].notna()) & (value_panel["lag_holdings"] > 0),
        value_panel["holdings_count"] / value_panel["lag_holdings"],
        np.nan,
    )

    cand = value_panel.loc[
        value_panel["value_ratio"].notna()
        & (value_panel["holdings_ratio"].isna() | (value_panel["holdings_ratio"] < 5))
    ].copy()
    cand = cand.sort_values(["cik", "value_ratio"], ascending=[True, False]).groupby("cik").head(1)
    cand["switch_on_event"] = cand["value_ratio"] > 50

    flags = value_panel.merge(
        cand[["cik", "rquarter", "switch_on_event"]],
        on=["cik", "rquarter"],
        how="left",
    )
    flags["switch_on_event"] = flags["switch_on_event"].fillna(False)
    flags["event"] = flags["switch_on_event"].astype(int)
    flags["unit_state"] = flags["initial_state"] + flags.groupby("cik")["event"].cumsum()
    flags["unit_state"] = flags["unit_state"].clip(0, 1).astype(int)
    flags["fallback"] = flags.groupby("cik")["portfolio_value"].transform(lambda s: (s >= 1e8).cumsum() > 0)
    flags["scale_down_flag"] = (flags["unit_state"] == 1) | flags["fallback"]

    out = holdext_raw.merge(
        flags[["cik", "rquarter", "value_ratio", "holdings_ratio", "scale_down_flag"]],
        on=["cik", "rquarter"],
        how="left",
    )
    out["scale_down_flag"] = out["scale_down_flag"].fillna(False)
    out["value"] = np.where(out["scale_down_flag"], out["value"] / 1000, out["value"])

    return out[[
        "filename",
        "cik",
        "cikname",
        "rdate",
        "rquarter",
        "fdate",
        "nameOfIssuer",
        "cusip",
        "value",
        "shares",
    ]].copy()


def build_missing_quarters_batch(batch_df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    holding_cols = ["nameOfIssuer", "cusip", "value", "shares"]

    cik_ranges = (
        batch_df[["cik", "rquarter"]]
        .drop_duplicates()
        .groupby("cik", as_index=False)
        .agg(min_rquarter=("rquarter", "min"), max_rquarter=("rquarter", "max"))
    )

    grid = cik_ranges.merge(rquarters.assign(key=1), how="cross").drop(columns=["key"])
    grid = grid.loc[(grid["rquarter"] >= grid["min_rquarter"]) & (grid["rquarter"] <= grid["max_rquarter"]), ["cik", "rquarter"]]

    filled = grid.merge(batch_df, on=["cik", "rquarter"], how="left")

    is_empty = filled[holding_cols].isna().all(axis=1)
    filled["missing_quarter"] = np.where(is_empty, 1, 0)

    filled = filled.sort_values(["cik", "rquarter"]).copy()
    filled["own_rquarter"] = np.where(filled["missing_quarter"] == 0, filled["rquarter"], pd.NaT)
    filled["prior_rquarter"] = filled.groupby("cik")["own_rquarter"].ffill()

    real_holdings = filled.loc[filled["missing_quarter"] == 0].copy()
    core_cols = [
        "filename",
        "cik",
        "cikname",
        "rdate",
        "rquarter",
        "fdate",
        "nameOfIssuer",
        "cusip",
        "value",
        "shares",
    ]

    real_holdings = real_holdings[core_cols].copy()

    locf_rows = filled.loc[filled["missing_quarter"] == 1, ["cik", "rquarter", "prior_rquarter"]].copy()
    source = real_holdings.rename(columns={"rquarter": "prior_rquarter"})

    locf = locf_rows.merge(source, on=["cik", "prior_rquarter"], how="left")
    locf = locf.rename(columns={"rquarter": "rquarter_new"})
    locf["rquarter"] = locf["rquarter_new"]
    locf = locf[core_cols].copy()

    out = pd.concat([real_holdings, locf], ignore_index=True)
    return out
```

# 3. Orchestration

```{python}
stage0 = build_holdext_raw()

stage1 = (
    stage0.pipe(clean_dates)
    .pipe(select_canonical_filings)
    .pipe(clean_cusip)
    .pipe(filter_outliers)
    .pipe(detect_unit_switches)
)

stage2_path = cfg.staging_dir / "holdext_raw_stage2_parquet"
if stage2_path.exists():
    shutil.rmtree(stage2_path)
stage2_path.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

cik_batch = (
    stage1[["cik"]]
    .drop_duplicates()
    .sort_values("cik")
    .reset_index(drop=True)
)
cik_batch["batch_id"] = [f"batch_{((i // 500) + 1):04d}" for i in range(len(cik_batch))]

stage2 = stage1.merge(cik_batch, on="cik", how="left")
for b, g in stage2.groupby("batch_id"):
    g.to_parquet(stage2_path / f"{b}.parquet", index=False)

stage3_path = cfg.derived_dir / "holdext_clean_parquet"
if stage3_path.exists():
    shutil.rmtree(stage3_path)
stage3_path.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

for b in sorted(cik_batch["batch_id"].unique()):
    batch_df = pd.read_parquet(stage2_path / f"{b}.parquet").drop(columns=["batch_id"])
    holdext_clean_batch = build_missing_quarters_batch(batch_df)
    holdext_clean_batch.to_parquet(stage3_path / f"{b}.parquet", index=False)

holdext_clean = pd.concat([pd.read_parquet(p) for p in sorted(stage3_path.glob("*.parquet"))], ignore_index=True)
```

# 4. Check and clean up

```{python}
gaps = (
    holdext_clean[["cik", "rquarter"]]
    .drop_duplicates()
    .sort_values(["cik", "rquarter"])
    .copy()
)

gaps["expected_next"] = gaps.groupby("cik")["rquarter"].shift(0).apply(lambda d: (pd.Timestamp(d) + pd.offsets.QuarterEnd(1)) if pd.notna(d) else pd.NaT)
gaps["actual_next"] = gaps.groupby("cik")["rquarter"].shift(-1)
gaps["has_gap"] = gaps["actual_next"].notna() & (gaps["actual_next"] != gaps["expected_next"])

n_gaps = int(gaps["has_gap"].sum())
if n_gaps == 0:
    shutil.rmtree(stage2_path, ignore_errors=True)
```

# 5. QA

```{python}
holdext_raw = pd.read_parquet(cfg.derived_dir / "holdext_raw_parquet.parquet")
holdext_clean = pd.concat([pd.read_parquet(p) for p in sorted((cfg.derived_dir / "holdext_clean_parquet").glob("*.parquet"))], ignore_index=True)
```

```{python}
raw_map = holdext_raw[["cik", "rdate"]].copy()
raw_map["rdate"] = pd.to_datetime(raw_map["rdate"], errors="coerce")
raw_map["rquarter"] = raw_map["rdate"].apply(quarter_end)

quarter_cmp = (
    raw_map[["cik", "rquarter"]]
    .drop_duplicates()
    .groupby("cik")
    .size()
    .reset_index(name="raw_n_q")
    .merge(
        holdext_clean[["cik", "rquarter"]]
        .drop_duplicates()
        .groupby("cik")
        .size()
        .reset_index(name="clean_n_q"),
        on="cik",
        how="outer",
    )
    .fillna(0)
)
quarter_cmp["diff_q"] = quarter_cmp["clean_n_q"] - quarter_cmp["raw_n_q"]

plt.figure(figsize=(8, 5))
xymax = max(quarter_cmp["raw_n_q"].max(), quarter_cmp["clean_n_q"].max())
plt.plot([0, xymax], [0, xymax], linestyle="--", color="grey")
sc = plt.scatter(quarter_cmp["raw_n_q"], quarter_cmp["clean_n_q"], c=quarter_cmp["diff_q"], s=10, alpha=0.6)
plt.colorbar(sc, label="Clean - raw")
plt.title("Number of rquarters per CIK: holdext_raw vs holdext_clean")
plt.xlabel("Raw number of rquarters")
plt.ylabel("Clean number of rquarters")
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig(qa_dir_05 / "qa_quarters_raw_vs_clean.png", dpi=300)
plt.close()
```

```{python}
example_cik = "0000002230"

raw_series = holdext_raw.copy()
raw_series["rdate"] = pd.to_datetime(raw_series["rdate"], errors="coerce")
raw_series["rquarter"] = raw_series["rdate"].apply(quarter_end)
raw_series = (
    raw_series.loc[raw_series["cik"] == example_cik]
    .groupby(["cik", "rquarter"], dropna=False)["value"]
    .sum()
    .reset_index(name="raw_portfolio_value")
)

clean_series = (
    holdext_clean.loc[holdext_clean["cik"] == example_cik]
    .groupby(["cik", "rquarter"], dropna=False)["value"]
    .sum()
    .reset_index(name="clean_portfolio_value")
)

both = raw_series.merge(clean_series, on=["cik", "rquarter"], how="inner")
both["raw_b"] = both["raw_portfolio_value"] / 1e9
both["clean_b"] = both["clean_portfolio_value"] / 1e9

plt.figure(figsize=(7, 4.5))
plt.plot(both["rquarter"], both["raw_b"], label="Raw")
plt.scatter(both["rquarter"], both["raw_b"], s=10)
plt.plot(both["rquarter"], both["clean_b"], label="Clean")
plt.scatter(both["rquarter"], both["clean_b"], s=10)
plt.title(f"Raw vs clean portfolio value for CIK {example_cik}")
plt.ylabel("Portfolio value (billions USD)")
plt.legend()
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig(qa_dir_05 / "qa_value_raw_vs_clean_example_cik.png", dpi=300)
plt.close()
```
